title: ESTsecurity says personal data in an external backup service may have been leaked
summary: Daily Security reports that ESTsecurity, maker of the ALYac antivirus, said in a notice on its website on 23 November that personal data of customer and partner contacts and former employees held in an external backup service may have been leaked. The company said the backup data was encrypted and no actual leak had been confirmed so far. The article says the number of people and the scope are still to be verified.
plain: ESTsecurity says personal data of customer and partner contacts and former employees, held in an external backup service, may have been leaked. The company says no actual leak has been confirmed so far.
exec: A Korean security vendor says contact and former-employee data in an outside backup may have leaked; it says no leak is confirmed.
action: General advice: companies using external backup services should check the provider's security and keep encryption keys stored separately, as the Daily Security article suggests.

sources.name: Daily Security (Korea): 알약 개발사 이스트시큐리티, 개인정보 유출 가능성 공지

validation.note: Only Daily Security's article was read; ESTsecurity's own notice could not be found or read. The article quotes the company's notice.
